reviews.author: Steffi Kaizun (Skaizun)
reviews.text: It works, but, it requires a bit of rigamarole to do so. After installing it, you have to go to click the Extensions icon on your Chrome toolbar, then click the Allow Copy icon, then click that pop-up's gear icon at the top right, then click Blacklist Mode, then go to the page you want to right-click-copy, click the Extensions icon, click the Allow Copy icon, then you should be able to copy/save the image. And, you have to do this for every web page every time you access it. Way too busy, but... Show more
